title: Builder and reviewer
starter: Show me the builder and the reviewer
intro: Two agents. One builds a small piece of work. A separate one reviews it against a fixed list, knowing nothing about how it was made, and sends corrections back. The work is done only when the review passes.
disclaimer: A working re-creation. The tasks are made up.
role: One agent builds. A separate agent reviews against a fixed list before the work reaches a person.
checklist: No exclamation marks, and no 'please' or 'sorry'
Says what the person should do next

scenarios.label: The message for a photo that is too big to upload
scenarios.brief: Write the message a person sees in the app when their photo upload fails because the file is over 10 MB.

prepared.first: Upload failed! Error 413: payload too large. The file exceeds the maximum size allowed.

verdict.note: Say what to do next: choose a smaller photo.

prepared.fixed: This photo is over the 10 MB limit. Choose a smaller photo, or reduce its size, and try again.

scenarios.label: The empty state for a to-do list
scenarios.brief: Write the text a person sees in the app when their to-do list has no tasks yet.

prepared.first: You have no tasks. You haven't added anything to your list.

verdict.note: Say how to add the first task.
'You haven't added anything' reads as blame.

prepared.fixed: Nothing here yet. Tap the plus button to add your first task.
